div.div: 4 اسخنهُ ; (L, Msb, K;) inf. n. إِسْخَانٌ, (S, L,) He heated it, or warmed it; made it hot, or warm; (S, * L, Msb, * K;) namely, water, (S, L, Msb,) &c.; (L, Msb;) as also ↓ سخّنهُ , (L, Msb, K,) inf. n. تَسْخِينٌ. (S, L.) And اسخن ٱللّٰهُ عَيْنَهُ, (S, L, K,) and بِعَيْنِهِ, (L, K,) [God made his eye to become hot, or heated, or inflamed, by weeping, or by grief or sorrow; or, simply,] made him to weep. (S, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
